asr_text: After one hour, the island and conversations start again. The buildings and even words from moments ago are reset. It is a hard world. But there is one way around this. Notes written down can go into the next hour. An AI test on an island inside a computer showed how much these strategy notes can matter. The AI agents sent to the island had no set tasks or rewards. But their starting settings led them to be curious, explore, and learn. They had no homework, but they were ready to explore. Then one AI made its own obstacle course. It placed eight blocks around a building called the Cathedral. Then it jumped across without touching the ground. It made the course and its rules all by itself. It kept itself busy, though nobody had asked it to. The researchers say this is a feature of play.
